title: Approved Artifact
description: Schema for approved artifact envelopes used for downstream consumption.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for this approved artifact envelope.

artifact_type.description: Approved artifact type for downstream consumers.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this approved_artifact payload.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this approved artifact envelope was created.

source_version_refs.description: Referenced source_version identifiers backing this artifact.

review_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the associated review_manifest identifier.

content_ref.description: Path or stable reference to approved content. Raw content is not embedded in this envelope.

content_hash.description: Content hash in sha256 format (with optional 'sha256:' prefix).

jurisdiction_scope.description: Jurisdictions covered by this approved artifact.

limitations.description: Known limitations attached to downstream consumption.

expires_at.description: Optional timestamp when this envelope expires.

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp until this envelope remains valid.

risk_level.description: Optional risk level for downstream prioritization.

profile_context_used.description: Optional profile context identifiers used in artifact preparation.
